profile.name: Harshit
profile.specialization: React · TypeScript · Astro · Next.js · Tailwind CSS
profile.bio: Frontend Developer with 9+ Months of hands-on experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, Astro, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Contributed to a live healthcare prescriber portal for a UK-based client, building reusable UI components and integrating RESTful APIs.

experience.summary: Engineered core modules of the production-ready YourMedicals Prescriber Portal, a live healthcare platform for a UK-based client.
highlights: Built 30+ reusable, accessible UI components using React.js, TypeScript, Astro, and Tailwind CSS, securing 95% layout consistency across all device viewports for a production-level UK healthcare portal.

Developed a high-performance Order Management Dashboard using TanStack Table, integrating RESTful APIs via Axios and optimizing state caching with TanStack Query to achieve 40% faster data-fetching speeds.
Collaborated with cross-functional Agile teams using Git, participating in sprint planning and code reviews to deliver production-ready code with sub-120ms API response latency.
